January 28, 2026
  CLA-2-23:OT:RR:NC:N5:231  
CATEGORY: Classification  
TARIFF NO.: 2309.90.9500
  Ms. Louise Arbour  PEV Import LLC  30 N. Gould Street  Suite N  Sheridan, WY 82801  RE: The tariff classification of Poultry Nutritional Supplements from Canada                    Dear Ms. Arbour:  In your letter dated January 4, 2026, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  The subject merchandise consists of four kinds of Poultry Nutritional Supplements.  Chick’N™ Calcium is a nutritional preparation formulated to supplement poultry diets through drinking  water. The product contains vitamins and minerals and does not include any ingredients classified as  veterinary drugs or medicated feed, as it is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. It is  intended for use with poultry, including broilers, layers, and turkeys, and is administered by dilution in  drinking water for nutritional and physiological support only.  Chick’N™ Vitamins+, also marketed as Chick’N™ Vita+, is a nutritional preparation designed to  supplement poultry diets via drinking water. The product contains vitamins A, D3, E, B-complex, and C;  minerals including calcium, magnesium, sodium, potassium, zinc, and copper; amino acids such as lysine and  methionine; and carriers including maltodextrin and mineral salts. It is intended for use with poultry and is  administered by dilution in drinking water for nutritional and physiological support only.  Chick’N™ Electrolyte, also known as Chick’N™ Electro+, is a nutritional preparation formulated to  supplement poultry diets through drinking water. The product contains vitamins A, D3, E, B-complex, and C;  minerals including calcium, magnesium, sodium, and potassium; and carriers such as maltodextrin and  mineral salts. It is intended for use with poultry and is administered by dilution in drinking water for  nutritional and physiological support only.  Chick’N™ Prebiotic+, also marketed as Chick’N™ Prebio+, is a nutritional preparation designed to  supplement poultry diets via drinking water. The product contains vitamins E and C; prebiotic substances 

including inulin and yeast derivatives; and carriers such as maltodextrin and mineral salts. It is intended for  use with poultry and is administered by dilution in drinking water for nutritional and physiological support  only.  You have proposed classification in subheading 2309.90.9400, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United  States (HTSUS). This specific subheading does not exist in the United States nomenclature.  The applicable subheading for the above-described Chick’N™ brand merchandise will be 2309.90.9500,  HTSUS, which provides for: “Preparations of a kind used in animal feeding: Other: Other: Other: Other.”    The general rate of duty will be 1.4 percent ad valorem.  Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS  and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at https://hts.usitc.gov/current.   The holding set forth above applies only to the specific factual situation and merchandise description as  identified in the ruling request.  This position is clearly set forth in Title 19, Code of Federal Regulations  (CFR), Section 177.9(b)(1).  This section states that a ruling letter is issued on the assumption that all of the  information furnished in the ruling letter, whether directly, by reference, or by implication, is accurate and  complete in every material respect.  In the event that the facts are modified in any way, or if the goods do not  conform to these facts at time of importation, you should bring this to the attention of CBP and submit a  request for a new ruling in accordance with 19 CFR 177.2.  Additionally, we note that the material facts  described in the foregoing ruling may be subject to periodic verification by CBP.  This merchandise is subject to The Public Health Security and Bioterrorism Preparedness and Response Act  of 2002 (The Bioterrorism Act), which is regulated by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). Information  on the Bioterrorism Act can be obtained by calling FDA at 301-575-0156, or at the Web site   www.fda.gov/oc/bioterrorism/bioact.html.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the  Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  A copy of the ruling or control number indicated above should be provided with entry documents filed at the  time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import  Specialist Ekeng Manczuk at ekeng.b.manczuk@cbp.dhs.gov.  
Sincerely,
  (for)  Denise Faingar  Designated Official Performing the Duties of the Division Director  National Commodity Specialist Division
